title: Where the effort goes
caption: What a machine can check, what AI can help with, and what only a human can check.
prose: Three boundaries: what a machine automates, what AI accelerates, and what only a human can decide.

three-boundaries.description: Document verification is three distinct jobs: deterministic machine checks, AI acceleration, and human judgment.

division-of-labour.description: Push mechanics to the machine and discovery to AI so humans only handle genuine judgment calls.

three-boundaries.title: Three non-interchangeable tiers
three-boundaries.keywords: machine, human, AI, deterministic to semantic
three-boundaries.script: It's not one job. It's three, and they're not interchangeable. On the left, the machine: deterministic — same input, same answer, every time. Binary: it passes or it fails. Cheap, and fast. This is the part you want doing as much as possible. On the right, the human: not deterministic, slow, expensive. This is where the semantic work happens — is this actually true, is it still useful. And it's still where almost all trust comes from. And in the middle, AI: it works in natural language, so it sits on the human side of that line — not deterministic. It costs tokens. What it can and can't be trusted with is genuinely unsettled.
three-boundaries.bridge: Left to right. Cheap and certain, to expensive and human. Let's take them in order.
